top.message: Line 1 must read "Type: Decision needed", "Type: Recommendation" or "Type: FYI".
Line 2 must start with "Bottom line: ", one sentence.
Line 3 must start with "Not looked at: ", what ISR could not see.
Line 4 must start with "Next: ", one action for the product owner.

script.title: ^# Acceptance script: \S
script.counts: \b(\d+) verified, (\d+) to check by hand, (\d+) to confirm(?:, (\d+) not covered)?\b

sections.heading: Already verified
sections.itemMessage: Each Already verified item says the outcome, then "Verified by:" and what checked it, from the record.

sections.heading: Confirm
sections.itemMessage: Each Confirm item asks a question and ends with where it came from in parentheses, like "(Unknown)" or "(inferred by the build)".

sections.heading: Not covered
sections.itemMessage: Each Not covered item reads "Criterion N: the reason".

story.notReady: ^(?:Call: Not ready yet|# Not ready yet)\s*$

record.bottomLine: ^Bottom line: The build is not verified yet\b

messages.layout: Leave line 5 blank, and put a blank line before every heading.
messages.title: Line 6 must be the title: "# Acceptance script: " and the story's title, or "# Not ready for acceptance: " and what the story is about.
messages.stray: This line doesn't belong here. Each section holds only its items, "None." or one "Not shown (N):" line.
messages.unknownSection: "{heading}" is not a section. The sections, in order: {order}.
messages.outOfOrder: "{heading}" is out of order. The sections, in order: {order}.
messages.missingSection: The "{heading}" section is missing. Write it with "None." if it has no items.
messages.headingCount: Write the heading with its count, like "## {heading} (3)".
messages.headerCount: {heading} says ({said}), but it shows {shown} and hides {hidden}.
messages.noneMixed: {heading} has items, so it can't also say "None."
messages.noneWithCount: {heading} says "None.", so its count must be (0).
messages.empty: {heading} is empty. List its items, or write "None."
messages.bottomCounts: The Bottom line must give the counts: "N verified, N to check by hand, N to confirm", plus ", N not covered" when Not covered is there.
messages.bottomMismatch: The Bottom line says {said} {what}, but the section says {count}.
messages.tooMany: {heading} shows {count} items. Show the top {max} and name the rest in one line: "Not shown (N): title; title".
messages.hiddenTooSoon: {heading} hides items while showing only {count}. Show {max} before hiding any.
messages.noCriterion: Say which criterion this covers, like "Criterion 2."
messages.checkNumber: Number the checks in order: expected "### {expected}."
messages.checkField: Check {n} is missing "{label}", or it is out of order. Each check has, in order: {order}.
messages.tooManySteps: Check {n} has {count} steps; the limit is {max}.
messages.longStep: Each step is one short sentence.
messages.riskOrder: Checks rank by risk: a {risk} check can't come after a {before} one.
messages.verdict: Remove this verdict or result field. ISR never records results; a person does, later.
messages.dash: Remove the {name}. Use a comma, a colon or a new sentence.
messages.doubleHyphen: Remove the double hyphen used as a dash. Use a comma, a colon or a new sentence.
messages.businessWords: Use business words for the tester: this looks like {what}.
messages.coverageMissing: Criterion {n} is missing. Every criterion appears once: Already verified, Check by hand or Not covered.
messages.coverageDuplicate: Criterion {n} appears more than once. It belongs in one place only.
messages.coverageUnknown: The story has no criterion {n}; it has {count}.
messages.missingStorySection: The story has no {section} section. Say so under Not looked at.
messages.storyNotReady: The story is not ready to build from, so write the not ready report, not a script.
messages.storyReady: The story has acceptance criteria, so write the acceptance script.
messages.notReadyNext: Next must point back to the story tool.
messages.noRecordVerified: No build record was given, so nothing counts as verified. Already verified must be (0).
messages.noRecordSaid: No build record was given. Say so under Not looked at, like "no build record was given".
messages.buildNotReadyType: The record shows the build is not verified ({why}), so Type must be "Decision needed".
messages.buildNotReadyBottom: The record shows the build is not verified ({why}). Start the Bottom line with "The build is not verified yet".
messages.movedType: A check moved to Confirm means a decision is needed, so Type must be "Decision needed".
